description: A lifted `<script>` whose body is a cell read is E-SCRIPT-001 (pre-S462 impl#1 built it with createElement and the cell data ran as JavaScript in Chromium).
rationale: §4.17 companion considerations: "`<script>` and `<style>` are NOT raw-content in scrml because scrml does not admit those elements at all." S462 amendment: the element is rejected with the same codes at EVERY position markup is parsed or built, decided on the parsed element, never on text.
